children: SPIE placed €500M senior notes due 2032 at 4.875% and launched a partial repurchase of its 2028 ORNANEs, with early redemption of remaining 2028 ORNANEs on Oct. 22, 2026. Repurchase results are expected Sept. 24, 2026.

ORNANE repurchase price ~135–135.25%

Near-term catalyst for equity and bonds; shows take-up and dilution risk.
Settlement of new notes Sept 28
